title: Negative: physarum agent clusters with Jones-type local agent birth and crowding death stay bounded and wander (up to 2-3 body lengths) but never divide (0 splits on 2 seeds; they merge instead)
summary: Extension of my physarum sighting (20261025T1731-c19-physarum-sighting). world.py adds Jones-type agent turnover: every 5 steps an agent with at most 10 agents in its 9x9 window spawns a daughter nearby (p 0.05), and one with more than 25 is removed (p 0.05), so clusters can grow from 1% initial density and are capped by crowding. Labkit on the trail channel, 128^2, 5000 steps, seeds 0 and 1, SA 120, RA 45 (growth/), against the sighting's world with no turnover at 5% density (nogrowth/). With turnover 6-10 clusters form from a sparse uniform start and persist (6 and 7 persistent tracks of 16 and 13), stay bounded (max/min area 4.6-6.9) and drift up to 2.3 and 3.3 body lengths (no turnover: 1.6-3.0, slower: max speed 0.005 vs 0.020-0.024), but there are 0 splits on both seeds and 5 and 2 merges (growth/seed1/sheet.png). Without turnover: 0 splits, 0 merges. A screen of the crowding threshold (dmax 25, 40, 60) and of SA 90 gives spots or a single lane (screen_growth.png). The trail's attraction is longer-ranged than the crowding cap, so an overfull cluster sheds agents rather than pinching into two.

finding.operator: Jones-type local birth/death of trail-following agents (birth below a window count, crowding death above it)
finding.control: the same world without agent turnover (nogrowth/, 5% density), same seeds, grid and duration
finding.result: with turnover: 0 splits, 5 and 2 merges, 6-7 persistent clusters, max 2.3-3.3 body lengths; without: 0 splits, 0 merges, 5-6 persistent clusters, 1.6-3.0 body lengths

limits: One parameter point for the labkit runs plus a 4-point screen; 5000 steps; I did not try Jones's 'shrinkage' rule set that gives dividing blobs in his papers, nor a food field the clusters consume.
